summary.text: Allen Cook is the Republican candidate for the New Hampshire House of Representatives, Rockingham 6, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Democrat Eric Turer.

paragraphs.text: Cook ran for the New Hampshire State Senate, District 23, in 2020, and lost the Republican primary to William Gannon on September 8, 2020, receiving 1,820 votes (26.6%) to Gannon's 5,000 (73.0%).
In 2024 he defeated Thaddeus Riley in the Republican primary for Rockingham 6, 443 votes to 327, and lost the November 5, 2024 general election to incumbent Eric Turer by 1,534 votes to 1,496.
Cook advanced from the Republican primary for the seat on September 8, 2026, with 478 votes.
